items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: He was playing bass with us at that time. One of the few old ones that I worked with.

ctx.x: I didn't know him. I knew about him. Yeah. Heard him on record.
He was playing bass with us at that time. One of the few old ones that I worked with.
I was going to ask you about an old bass player. Did you ever know Johnny Prudence?
